en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long pergola/colonnade covered with climbing plants in the spa garden of Bad Pyrmont. A few people stroll under the columns. Caption at bottom reads "Bad Pyrmont – Säulengang im Kurgarten." The reverse has green "Postkarte," a Deutsches Reich stamp postmarked 26.5.11, an advertisement for Café‑Restaurant Knierim on the Hauptallee, a handwritten message and an address to Goslar, plus a museum stamp.
